items: **NEO Options.** NEO → Options… (File → Options… on Windows and Linux) gathers NEO's features in one place: outline cards, notes pages, poetry, footnotes, pen names, page views, focus, vim keys, more exports and the rest. Turn on what you use; the menus show only what's on.
**NEO Pocket gets Options as well** (⋯ → Options…): outline cards, notes pages, poetry, footnotes, pen names, vim keys and plain text, Markdown and web page exports, on when you want them.
